events.label: fix(db): PrismaPg requires explicit pg.Pool with SSL — config object form silently breaks Supabase pooler
events.desc:
PrismaPg({ connectionString }) creates the adapter but the underlying pool
never establishes SSL on the Supabase pooler (port 6543), causing every
Prisma runtime query to throw. This silently broke Auth.js VerificationToken
writes, receipt creates, and all DB operations in production.

Fix: pass new Pool({ connectionString, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
explicitly so SSL terminates correctly against aws-1-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
